import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
acct = df[df.account_id=='frHBxlu'].copy()
key=['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']
# find combos with step change: compare mean cost of last 3 days (10-13..15) vs previous 6 days, normalized by overall volatility
res=[]
for k,g in acct.groupby(key):
    g=g.sort_values('date').set_index('date')['unblended_cost']
    if len(g)<10: continue
    pre=g[:'2025-10-12']; post=g['2025-10-13':]
    ratio=post.mean()/pre.mean()
    res.append((k,ratio,pre.std()))
r=pd.DataFrame(res,columns=['key','ratio','std'])
print(r.ratio.describe())

df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
acct = df[df.account_id=='frHBxlu'].copy()
key=['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']
# find combos with step change: compare mean cost of last 3 days (10-13..15) vs previous 6 days, normalized by overall volatility
res=[]
for k,g in acct.groupby(key):
    g=g.sort_values('date').set_index('date')['unblended_cost']
    if len(g)<10: continue
    pre=g[:'2025-10-12']; post=g['2025-10-13':]
    ratio=post.mean()/pre.mean()
    res.append((k,ratio,pre.std()))
r=pd.DataFrame(res,columns=['key','ratio','std'])
print(r.ratio.describe())
"}

{"code": "import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
acct = df[df.account_id=='frHBxlu'].copy()
acct['dow']=acct.date.dt.day_of_week
key=['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']
out=[]
for k,g in acct.groupby(key):
    pre=g[g.date<'2025-10-13']
    base=pre.groupby('dow')['unblended_cost'].mean()
    sd=pre['unblended_cost'].std()
    anom=g[g.date>='2025-10-13'].copy()
    if len(anom)==0 or sd==0: continue
    exp=anom['dow'].map(base)
    z=(anom['unblended_cost']-exp).mean()/sd
    out.append((k,z))
r=pd.DataFrame(out,columns=['key','z']).sort_values('z',ascending=False)
print(r.head(8).to_string())
"}
